# Volcanic island: an 11-sided slab (top at z 0) whose top is fanned and subdivided into small
# triangles, so a lava pool, its channel to the rim and glowing cracks are picked as faces (no decals).
# A rocky underside cone. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.020 0.122 0.224 --no-slot
material new Crack --base-color 0.773 0.227 0.616 --emission 0.773 0.227 0.616 --no-slot
material new Lava --base-color 1.000 0.557 0.502 --emission 1.000 0.557 0.502 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Island --vertices 11 --radius 3.6 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 -0.25
apply --location
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
subdivide --cuts 6
# a gently uneven top, flat where the forge and the trip-hammer stand, the rim edge kept
select vert where "pos.z > -0.01 && sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y) < 3.35 && !((abs(pos.x) < 1.45 && pos.y > -0.75 && pos.y < 2.35) || (abs(pos.x + 1.6) < 0.45 && abs(pos.y + 0.05) < 0.45))"
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 4
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && sqrt((pos.x - 1.4)*(pos.x - 1.4) + (pos.y - (-1.6))*(pos.y - (-1.6))) < 0.8"
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && (sqrt((pos.x - ((1.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.400))*(0.863) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.010)) / 1.7649, 0, 1)*(0.863)))*(pos.x - ((1.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.400))*(0.863) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.010)) / 1.7649, 0, 1)*(0.863))) + (pos.y - ((-1.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.400))*(0.863) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.010)) / 1.7649, 0, 1)*(-1.010)))*(pos.y - ((-1.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.400))*(0.863) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.010)) / 1.7649, 0, 1)*(-1.010)))) < 0.2)" --extend
material assign Lava
translate 0 0 -0.12
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((-0.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (-0.600))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(-0.600)) / 0.7200, 0, 1)*(-0.600)))*(pos.x - ((-0.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (-0.600))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(-0.600)) / 0.7200, 0, 1)*(-0.600))) + (pos.y - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-0.600))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(-0.600)) / 0.7200, 0, 1)*(-0.600)))*(pos.y - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-0.600))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(-0.600)) / 0.7200, 0, 1)*(-0.600)))) < 0.17) || (sqrt((pos.x - ((-1.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.200))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-0.300)))*(pos.x - ((-1.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.200))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-0.300))) + (pos.y - ((-1.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.200))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-1.000)))*(pos.y - ((-1.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.200))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.600))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-1.000)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((0.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.500))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.200))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-0.300)))*(pos.x - ((0.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.500))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.200))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-0.300))) + (pos.y - ((-1.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.500))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.200))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-1.000)))*(pos.y - ((-1.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.500))*(-0.300) + (pos.y - (-1.200))*(-1.000)) / 1.0900, 0, 1)*(-1.000)))) < 0.17) || (sqrt((pos.x - ((0.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.200))*(0.400) + (pos.y - (-2.200))*(-0.900)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(0.400)))*(pos.x - ((0.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.200))*(0.400) + (pos.y - (-2.200))*(-0.900)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(0.400))) + (pos.y - ((-2.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.200))*(0.400) + (pos.y - (-2.200))*(-0.900)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(-0.900)))*(pos.y - ((-2.200) + clamp(((pos.x - (0.200))*(0.400) + (pos.y - (-2.200))*(-0.900)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(-0.900)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((-1.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.500))*(-0.900) + (pos.y - (0.000))*(0.400)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(-0.900)))*(pos.x - ((-1.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.500))*(-0.900) + (pos.y - (0.000))*(0.400)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(-0.900))) + (pos.y - ((0.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.500))*(-0.900) + (pos.y - (0.000))*(0.400)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(0.400)))*(pos.y - ((0.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.500))*(-0.900) + (pos.y - (0.000))*(0.400)) / 0.9700, 0, 1)*(0.400)))) < 0.17) || (sqrt((pos.x - ((-2.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-2.400))*(-0.700) + (pos.y - (0.400))*(-0.200)) / 0.5300, 0, 1)*(-0.700)))*(pos.x - ((-2.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-2.400))*(-0.700) + (pos.y - (0.400))*(-0.200)) / 0.5300, 0, 1)*(-0.700))) + (pos.y - ((0.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-2.400))*(-0.700) + (pos.y - (0.400))*(-0.200)) / 0.5300, 0, 1)*(-0.200)))*(pos.y - ((0.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-2.400))*(-0.700) + (pos.y - (0.400))*(-0.200)) / 0.5300, 0, 1)*(-0.200)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((1.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.500))*(0.800) + (pos.y - (0.300))*(0.300)) / 0.7300, 0, 1)*(0.800)))*(pos.x - ((1.500) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.500))*(0.800) + (pos.y - (0.300))*(0.300)) / 0.7300, 0, 1)*(0.800))) + (pos.y - ((0.300) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.500))*(0.800) + (pos.y - (0.300))*(0.300)) / 0.7300, 0, 1)*(0.300)))*(pos.y - ((0.300) + clamp(((pos.x - (1.500))*(0.800) + (pos.y - (0.300))*(0.300)) / 0.7300, 0, 1)*(0.300)))) < 0.17) || (sqrt((pos.x - ((2.300) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.300))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (0.600))*(0.800)) / 1.1300, 0, 1)*(0.700)))*(pos.x - ((2.300) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.300))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (0.600))*(0.800)) / 1.1300, 0, 1)*(0.700))) + (pos.y - ((0.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.300))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (0.600))*(0.800)) / 1.1300, 0, 1)*(0.800)))*(pos.y - ((0.600) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.300))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (0.600))*(0.800)) / 1.1300, 0, 1)*(0.800)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.000))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (2.400))*(0.200)) / 0.4000, 0, 1)*(-0.600)))*(pos.x - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.000))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (2.400))*(0.200)) / 0.4000, 0, 1)*(-0.600))) + (pos.y - ((2.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.000))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (2.400))*(0.200)) / 0.4000, 0, 1)*(0.200)))*(pos.y - ((2.400) + clamp(((pos.x - (-1.000))*(-0.600) + (pos.y - (2.400))*(0.200)) / 0.4000, 0, 1)*(0.200)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && material == 0 && ((sqrt((pos.x - ((2.100) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.100))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(0.400)) / 0.6500, 0, 1)*(0.700)))*(pos.x - ((2.100) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.100))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(0.400)) / 0.6500, 0, 1)*(0.700))) + (pos.y - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.100))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(0.400)) / 0.6500, 0, 1)*(0.400)))*(pos.y - ((-1.000) + clamp(((pos.x - (2.100))*(0.700) + (pos.y - (-1.000))*(0.400)) / 0.6500, 0, 1)*(0.400)))) < 0.17))"
material assign Crack
translate 0 0 -0.03
mode object
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 11 --radius1 0.6 --radius2 3.5500000000000003 --depth 3.0 --location 0 0 -2.0
material assign Rock
active Under
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select vert where "pos.z < 1.4"
randomize --amount 0.3 --seed 9
# a few glowing seams on the underside too
select face where "pos.z < 0.8 && pos.z > -0.6 && (index % 5 == 0)"
material assign Crack
mode object
select all
shade flat
export island.glb
